node.statement: If 0<=t<=1, A is a t-C*-algebra, ||R-I||<=t, and L_R R_R(X)=R(XR), then ||L_R R_R-I_A||<=21*t in operator norm. This uses only bilinearity, ||UV||<=(1+t)||U||||V||, ||UI-U||,||IU-U||<=t||U||, and | ||I||-1 |<=t||U||/||U|| as supplied by def-epsilon-cstar-algebra.
